description: Noise artifacts — the entropy floor and its seeded imitators.

noise_floor.description: The noise seam. Left: gradient (simplex) noise - the smooth seeded field procgen calls 'noise', the same every run, rewindable, ownable. Right: white noise - a fresh value per cell, structureless, the incompressible entropy floor. The left is a crank in a smoother coat; the right is real noise, and it is the one procgen never uses because a shapeless field builds no world.
noise_floor.name: Noise Floor
noise_floor.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for noise. Bias is conserved; show the seam.

the_same_cloud.name: The Same Cloud
the_same_cloud.description: The noise SUPER OBJECT: a weather bureau where every station reads ONE FastNoiseLite (seed 4) and disagrees only about how - white scream vs coherent promise, three frequency zooms, an octave stair, four noise_type temperaments, a vane field of samples-as-angles, a relief bench, a real domain_warp pair, and a thresholded coastline. Noise is a function, not a dice cup. 2026-08-27.

related_weather.name: Related weather
related_weather.description: Three glazed viewing walls expose the latest eight samples as sight slits. Shared uniform innovations drive a fresh signal, accumulated steps and an approximate pink filter. Identical travel and aperture limits; fixed glass retains body collision. Local run/hold, single step, replay and fresh-seed controls. Raw signal verification and limits documented separately.
interactions: Walk alongside the eight retained moments
Look through the aligned or separated slits
Hold during motion and finish a step
Replay the seeded record or choose a new seed
related_weather.qfep_connection: Memory can be written into a process and into its display. A smooth-looking wall may owe its agreement to filtering, to the shared motor, or to clipping at a limit. Different relations admit different views.
